crossRefs.note: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land, behold, darkness and…
and look to the earth, and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.
There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.
The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.
For, behold, darkness will cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but Yahweh will arise on you, and his glory…
Give glory to Yahweh your God, before he causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and while…
A day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness. As the dawn spreading on the mountains, a great…
“Woe to you who desire the day of Yahweh! Why do you long for the day of Yahweh? It is darkness, and not light.
Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.
For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for…
Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not…
To the others he said in my hearing, “Go through the city after him, and strike. Don’t let your eye spare, neither have…
The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood…
For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her…
For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness…

translations.web: Through Yahweh of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up; and the people are the fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.
translations.bsb: By the wrath of the LORD of Hosts the land is scorched, and the people are fuel for the fire. No man even spares his brother.
translations.kjv: Through the wrath of the LORD of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.
translations.asv: Through the wrath of Jehovah of hosts is the land burnt up; and the people are as the fuel of fire: no man spareth his brother.
